label: Peak mortality of the 1918 influenza pandemic

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: The period of highest mortality in the USA and Europe occurred between late September and mid-December of 1918, with the greatest overall peak in late October 1918; the October 4 New Moon fell in the 8th house of the Libra Ingress chart and squared the 6th-house cusp of illness.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green assigns public health or sickness to the sixth house and public mortality to the eighth house in mundane astrology.

notes: Seed epidemic case anchored to the 1918 influenza appendix in the annotated Raphael corpus.

label: Second influenza mortality spike in Britain, early 1919

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: On 25 January 1919 Saturn retrograde opposed Uranus, and a second but less severe peak in the death rate occurred in the UK in February 1919; Saturn lay in the 6th house of illness of the Aries Ingress chart and opposed Uranus in the 12th house of hospitalization.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says Mars is significant in connection with health and disease, infectious diseases, epidemics, and fevers, while the sixth and eighth houses govern public health and public mortality.

notes: Secondary-wave seed used to keep epidemic modeling from collapsing into single-peak logic.

label: Black Death in England

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Carter says the Black Death reached England in 1349 and had immense social consequences.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Carter states that mundane astrology includes earthquakes, droughts, epidemics, and other collective catastrophes whose particulars are historically recorded with relevant detail.

notes: Long-cycle historical anchor for epidemic catastrophe as a first-class mundane domain.

label: Plague deaths in India under the Saturn-Uranus conjunction in Scorpio

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: The conjunction of Saturn and Uranus, and that of Uranus and Neptune, are generally connected with serious pestilence and famines, and the last conjunction of Saturn and Uranus in Scorpio caused many deaths through plague in India.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says malefic long-cycle transits and conjunctions can accompany epidemics, and that Mars can correlate with fires, accidents, assaults, or epidemics when affecting the relevant sign or city points.

notes: Cross-source plague case to broaden public-health coverage beyond the 1918 influenza family and Black Death anchor.
